title: El Cielo | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Newly Constructed with Phenomenal Panoramic Views Located South of 30A
description_expanded: Description: El Cielo by Royal Destinations Location: Seacrest Beach Address: 7952 E County Highway 30A, Inlet Beach, FL 32461 Details: El Cielo is a modern new-construction masterpiece offering some of the most stunning Gulf views on 30A. Positioned directly on Scenic Highway 30A and just 463 feet from the nearest beach access, this home delivers exceptional convenience and an unmatched coastal setting. Inside, guests will find elevated finishes throughout and professionally curated décor that enhances every spacious accommodation. A private elevator services all levels, including the impressive top floor. This upper-level retreat features a covered lounge, an open sun deck, and a TV—creating the ideal gathering oasis surrounded by panoramic Gulf views. Every detail has been meticulously considered, ensuring this home provides the perfect setting for a truly unforgettable 30A vacation. Home Highlights: - Unobstructed Panoramic Gulf Views - Distance To Beach Access: 463 Feet (2-Minute Walk) - Elevator - Located Directly on 30A - Beach Towels Provided During Stay - New Construction - Professional Interior Design - Outdoor Shower - All En Suite Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 13 3 Bedrooms Plus Bunk Area / 3 Full Baths / 1 Half Baths / 1 Beach Shower First Floor: - Bedroom 1: King Bed with Attached Bath (Shower), Smart TV - Bunk Alcove: Twin XL/Twin XL Bunks with Bathroom Access Second Floor: - Bedroom 3: King Bed with Private Bath, (Shower/Vessel Tub) Smart TV - Bedroom 4: Queen Bed, Twin Daybed with Trundle with Private Bath (Tub/Shower Combo), Smart TV - Open Space with Full Daybed and Twin Trundle -Laundry Third Floor: - Open Concept Great Room Including Living, Kitchen, Island with Seating, Dining, Half Bath Fourth Floor: - Outdoor Living with Covered and Uncovered Spaces, Sundeck, Stunning Views, TV Please Note: Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
